name: OpenAI
description: OpenAI for the Generated Image: the API key and the models it may use, shared by the OpenAI Text and OpenAI Image parts.

credit.text: Text and pictures generated by OpenAI's models

properties.name: apiKey
properties.title: API Key
properties.description: Your OpenAI API key. Test asks OpenAI which image models it may use.

properties.name: modelsCacheHours
properties.title: Keep the Model List (hours)
properties.description: How long the list of models OpenAI lets the key use is kept for the forms and tasks. A new or retired model shows up after this. 0: ask every time.

properties.name: staleDays
properties.title: Forget Unused Answers After (days)
properties.description: A kept model list nobody has used for this many days (an old key's) is removed. 0: never.

properties.name: monthlyQuota
properties.title: Monthly Quota (calls)
properties.description: The calls your OpenAI plan allows in a month. Only you know it, and the service is not asked. The System page's API usage card shows this period's calls against it, with a warning from 80%. Once it is used, the source stops calling and uses what it kept until the period resets. Empty: no limit.

properties.name: quotaResetDay
properties.title: Quota Resets On (day of the month)
properties.description: The day of the month your plan starts counting again (1 to 28), in the device's time zone. The period the bar shows starts on that day.
